# Pagination

Moves through pages of a list or table.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Pagination` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Pagination />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Pagination"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Page through a list: Previous, numbers with ellipses, Next.

## Props (PaginationProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | `number` | Current page, from 1. @default 1 |
| `count` | `number` | Total pages. @default 1 |
| `onChange` | `(page: number) => void` |  |
| `siblings` | `number` | Numbers shown on each side of the current page. @default 1 |
| `compact` | `boolean` | "Page 2 of 9" between the arrows. @default false |
| `hrefFor` | `(page: number) => string` | Render real links. |
| `label` | `string` | @default "Pagination" |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'onChange'>._
